incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE FIRED for team-private — Private control plane unreachable for customer acme-corp (private/VPC). Pager: P12345. Impact: agent heartbeats missing, control plane API 10.2.5.12:8443 unresponsive.

pagerduty: Trigger P12345 assigned to ryan (oncall). Escalation policy: oncall -> eng-infra -> oncall-lead.

ryan (oncall): ack. I'm on it. pinging team.

maria (sre): seeing spike in control-plane CPU + no heartbeats from acme-01 and acme-02 agents. Can someone reach the customer VPC from our VPN?

charlie (eng-infra): trying quick connectivity check to 10.2.5.12 from jump host in us-west-2: `curl -v http://10.2.5.12:8443/health` -> times out. traceroute stops at 10.0.0.1 (customer edge).

acme-netops (customer): We pushed a maintenance change ~10m ago (BGP route withdraw for consolidation). We didn't expect to cut reachability to the management IPs — investigating with ISP now.

ryan (oncall): ok, customer-confirmed maintenance. This looks like a network reachability issue rather than control plane process crash. Maria, can we surface agent-side logs and last-seen timestamps?

maria (sre): pulling last-seen from heartbeat DB: acme-01 last seen 1803456760, acme-02 last seen 1803456748. Both stopped ~2.5m before page.

charlie (eng-infra): posted command for acme to run on their edge device:```sudo ip route show table main | grep 10.2.5.12```asking them to confirm route to 10.2.5.12 via ipsec tunnel. Also asked for `show bgp summary` and `ipsec status` output.

acme-netops (customer): here's output from their side: `show bgp summary` shows neighbor flapping; `ipsec status` shows SA rekey failures. ISP says BGP flap during maintenance, they are reverting.

ryan (oncall): good. Mitigation plan: 1) ask customer/ISP to restore BGP/route to control plane IPs. 2) once route stable, we will confirm agent heartbeats, else restart agent and collect full logs. 3) postmortem + network hardening follow-up.

sarah (support): opened support case S-91234 for acme-corp and notified account team. Adding contact: jane@acme.com.

charlie (eng-infra): recommended short-term workaround: allow fallback over relay (if enabled) — but for acme they've disabled relay for compliance, so not available. Noted in case file.

ryan (oncall): pinging customer to confirm when ISP reverts. Also leaving quick reproduction steps for whoever picks this up: `curl` from jump host -> if times out, run `mtr` to the edge, request BGP neighbor stability.

acme-netops (customer): ISP rolled back change. BGP neighborship stable now. We see routes to 10.2.5.12 returned.

charlie (eng-infra): re-checking from jump host: `curl -v http://10.2.5.12:8443/health` -> 200 OK. H/T: control plane healthy.

maria (sre): heartbeat DB shows acme-01 last seen 1803457030, acme-02 last seen 1803457045 — heartbeats resumed. Will tail logs to ensure stability: `journalctl -u redwood-agent -f` shows reconnects and normal operation.

ryan (oncall): great. Confirming restore to customer and closing pager. Follow-ups: collect full network packet captures during outage window (requested from acme/ISP), add explicit runbook step to validate BGP routes after maintenance, and verify relay fallback docs for compliance customers.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: P12345 is auto-resolved (ack -> resolved) by ryan (oncall).

ryan (oncall): handing off to maria for follow-up and postmortem. Summary for handoff: private control plane unreachable due to customer-side BGP/IPsec maintenance causing route withdrawal to control plane IPs; impact: ~5m of missed heartbeats, no customer traffic dropped by platform (control plane unreachable only). Actions taken: engaged customer/ISP, confirmed rollback, validated control plane health and agent reconnection, created support case S-91234.

maria (sre): taking postmortem. I'll schedule a 1:1 with acme-netops and ISP to get PCAPs and concrete timeline. Also will propose adding a pre-maintenance checklist for route maintenance in runbook.

ryan (oncall): handing over final slack notes to oncall log and closing thread. :thumbsup: :eyes:
